versions.changelog:
**Summary:** This version removes central mail hub support, shifting to a fully local, per-workspace best-effort mailbox.

- Central mail hub and sync scripts removed; now only per-workspace inbox, keep, and archive folders.
- All references to a shared/central registry, hub, or catch-up sync deleted.
- Only local best-effort fanout/delivery is supported; cloud or remote delivery explicitly not implemented.
- Documentation and AGENTS.md snippet updated for the simplified, local-only flow.
- File and mailbox structure clarified; security and usage boundaries re-emphasized.

**Switched to a central mail hub and added persistent "keep" folder.**  
- Added central mail hub (`~/.openclaw/.agent-mail-hub/`) for canonical copies and easy agent catch-up.  
- Per-workspace mailboxes now include a `keep/` folder and `.keep-index.md` for retained/durable context.  
- New scripts: `keep-mailbox.sh` (move/track retained mail), `sync-from-hub.sh` (install/startup catch-up).  
- On startup, mail check now reviews retained "keep" items, then new inbox mail (`list-mailbox.sh startup`).  
- Removed obsolete `skill-card.md`; updated docs for hub, keep, and new startup/read flow.

- Major simplification: Replaced previous full CLI/API TypeScript codebase with lightweight shell scripts for core mailbox operations.
- Redesigned documentation to clarify new minimal, local, best-effort mailbox model and narrow the feature scope.
- Removed cloud sync, webhook, guaranteed delivery, and execution workflow claims; mailbox is now strictly local and advisory.
- Added shell scripts for mailbox init, send, list, archive, and cleanup.
- Removed all previous Node.js source, package files, and TS docs/examples.
- Target use case: very lightweight, low-noise, per-workspace mail fanout for agent coordination without chat or memory bloat.
